title: Circuitry
subtitle: A circuits workbook
summary: For someone who can solder but can't yet design. The wires in every circuit are coloured by their voltage, so you can watch a capacitor fill or a transistor switch on. The last four lessons, still being written, open up two guitar pedals, a Fuzz Face and a Tube Screamer, and size an off-grid solar system from the panel down.
